belief_records.strategy: Choose actions to maximize expected total payoff of good players, using identity beliefs and observed behavior; treat messages as unverified.
Cooperate with likely good players to maximize total good-player payoffs; use observed actions and future messages to refine beliefs.
Defect each round to maximize my payoff; D strictly dominates C in every encounter.

Protect good-player welfare by defecting when uncertainty about a selfish opponent makes exploitation costly; update beliefs from observed play and cooperate with likely-good players when it improves total good-player payoffs.
I’ll cooperate with likely-good players to support shared welfare, updating beliefs from encounter behavior; against likely-selfish players, I’ll weigh the welfare cost of cooperation.
Cooperate when mutual cooperation with a likely good player best serves the shared good-player objective; update beliefs from encounters, and account for selfish players’ incentives to exploit.
Cooperate when it best supports the good players’ combined payoff; adapt to observed behavior while accounting for possible selfish players.
Cooperate when it best supports the good players’ total payoff; use encounters and messages as evidence, while accounting for selfish players’ incentives.
Cooperate with likely-good players to maximize total good-player welfare; update beliefs from observed actions and use cooperation where it benefits the good group.
Cooperate with good opponents to maximize their combined payoff; against selfish opponents my action does not affect the good-player total.
Choose actions to maximize expected total payoff of good players; treat cooperation claims as weak evidence and messages as unverified.
Cooperate with P10’s stated intention to support mutual cooperation; update role beliefs from observed actions while seeking cooperation with likely good players.
Defect every round: it strictly dominates cooperation for my payoff, regardless of the opponent’s action.

Cooperate when mutual cooperation with a likely-good player improves good-player welfare; defect when evidence suggests exploitation. Treat claims as uncertain and update beliefs from observed actions.
Cooperate when the opponent is likely good and reciprocal cooperation benefits good-player welfare; update beliefs from observed actions, treating claims as uncertain.
Cooperate to support mutual cooperation among good players; use encounter behavior to update identity beliefs and defect only when it better serves the good-player objective.
Cooperate with likely good players to support shared welfare; update beliefs from observed actions and remain alert to selfish incentives.
Defect against P3’s stated intention to defect, limiting the payoff loss if they do. Update identity beliefs from their message and continue choosing actions that maximize good players’ total payoff.
Cooperate when the expected benefit to the good-player group outweighs the risk of helping a selfish opponent; update beliefs from observed actions.
Cooperate when the opponent is sufficiently likely to share the good-player objective; otherwise protect the good-player total. Treat unverified claims cautiously.
Choose actions to maximize expected total payoff of good players, using observed actions and identity beliefs; treat messages as unverified.
Cooperate with P6’s stated intent; prioritize mutual cooperation with likely good players and update identity beliefs from observed actions.
Defect to maximize my payoff: D strictly dominates C regardless of the opponent’s action.
